notes:
Common direct conformance reproduced CLI priority now accepted despite declared unsupported steering, while SDK rejects. Parent correcting CLI submitPrompt priority policy and focused regression; do not weaken shared assertion. Abort of already-ended toolUse requires testing next result/channel state rather than expecting mutation of completed round.
Claude2.1.280 added public MCP description truncation default2048 characters (primary env-vars docs retrievedSep30). Effective host/native instructions must reach runtime intact: root will set child CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_MCP_DESCRIPTION_LENGTH at least longest advertised host description for both drivers and add offline transport receipts. No host-specific imports or new dependencies.
Native adapter/core round integration exposed assistant empty-text elision: hosts can omit empty text blocks, while core history acknowledgment hashes retained them and rebuilt unnecessarily. Root will canonicalize assistant empty text for digest only, preserving whitespace/thinking/call order/errors, and test resident reuse plus actual-history divergence.
Official runtime env-vars docs state CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL overrides CLI effort flags. Both drivers must set that child value when a host explicitly requests effort, so inherited global settings cannot override the capability-validated request. Parent adds conflicting-inherited-value regression for both transports.
Adapter integration proved unsupported steering can bypass old post-acquire guard through a rebuilt/replay round. Root moving rejection before acquisition, closing affected parked resources, and testing fresh and parked boundaries. Current CLI/SDK advertise unsupported; no speculative new steering feature or duplicate replay is allowed.
